messages:
Samara (Partnerships): New partner asset pack from EdgeGrid v3. They included alternative logo lockups and a customer cred. Need quick review for marketplace and co-branded one-pager. Can design + legal eyeball?
Ezra (Design): I'll check assets. Can we confirm export specs: marketplace tile 1200x1200 PNG, hero 1200x628 PNG, logos in SVG + PNG, and a print-ready PDF for the one-pager. Also need alt text and a 140-char blurb.
EdgeGrid Legal: Provided an email approving logo use and co-branding with restrictions: no logo modification, maintain clear space, and use white or primary lockup only. Attached license email: "GC OK to use as-is."
Priya (Legal): Thanks. I'll archive the license. Follow-up: the license text forbids altering the mark; do we need a separate badge for SI partner Northstar? That will require another permission.
Cara (Marketing): Confirmed we need the 140-char blurb and an alt-text line. Suggest blurb: "EdgeGrid and Redwood power low-latency inference at the edge." EdgeGrid PM okayed.
Ezra (Design): Minor visual flag: EdgeGrid's primary blue (#0066CC) sits close to our tile background. Recommend placing a 16px dark gradient behind the mark and using the white lockup. Also added alt text: "EdgeGrid and Redwood delivering low-latency inference at the edge."
Samara (Partnerships): Great. On the customer quote: they sent "Cut inference tail latency by 40%". Legal okayed including it only if Northstar and the end customer sign off too. EdgeGrid is pinging both.
uploader-bot: Files uploaded to partners drive: /edgegrid/v3/asset_pack.zip. Files present: `edgegrid_mark.svg`, `edgegrid_mark_white.png`, `edgegrid_hero_1200x628.png`, `edgegrid_tile_1200x1200.png`, `edgegrid_onepager_a4.pdf`, `meta/alt_text.txt`, `meta/140char_blurb.txt`.
Priya (Legal): Noted. Keep quote in drafts as placeholder until attestation. We'll include a line: "Customer-approved metric pending; placeholder uses qualitative phrasing."
Cara (Marketing): I'll draft the marketplace listing with neutral phrasing and swap in the numeric claim if we get signed attestation. Also need the SI badge question resolved.
Samara (Partnerships): EdgeGrid Legal confirmed they're looping Northstar legal for the SI badge. ETA 24 hrs. If we don't have both badges, we will publish with only EdgeGrid.
Ezra (Design): Locking export specs now and will upload a marketing-ready pack with both 1:1 and hero variants, plus alt text and sample SEO blurb.
Samara (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with legal confirmations. If Northstar confirms, we will add their badge and update alt text.
